Name: Desert Festival Funding
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Desert Festival Funding lets you schedule a Desert Festival outside of spring. Once the Community Centre vault is restored and the bus is running again, Mayor Lewis will send you a letter explaining how to get involved. From the 21st of each month, you can spend gold to fund a 3-day Desert Festival in the next available slot on the calendar. All the usual festival content is there — including the cactus guy.
[line]
[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Fund a Desert Festival for Summer, Fall, or Winter once the bus is repaired[/*]
[*]Festival is automatically scheduled on the next available date with no conflicts[/*]
[*]Get multiple random cactus per year.[/*]
[*]Funding opens on the 21st of each month for the next, and locks once a festival is already scheduled[/*]
[*]Configurable cost, minimum notice period, and funding location via GMCM[/*]
[/list][line]
Quick Warning: Quitting on a day with a desert festival will break it. When reloading your save that day will not be a Desert Festival day any longer. There is no fix as my mod simply tells the game to put an event on certain days and unfortunately the day schedule already loads by the time my mod can tell the system its a desert festival so it gets skipped entirely. 

Also heads up, it SHOULD work with multiplayer but only the host can get an extra cactus and fund the festival.

ALSO ALSO: I hardcoded the times you can schedule a festival, it avoids other festivals and the 1st and 22nd (cause the first is tricky and the 22nd is a SVE event.)
